parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the wall cabinet, made of plywood with a rectangular box shape.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the shelves and door, maintaining the cabinet’s rigidity and shape.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports other components.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of plywood, used for supporting stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet’s internal space into sections for organized storage.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the frame with hinges, featuring a handle for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close the cabinet.
